ABOUT US

Three decades of trusted service

Under the leadership of Shri Sachin B. Desai, Government Electrical Supervisor & Contractor, we've built a reputation for reliability, genuine products, and excellent customer service across the region.

Frequently asked questions

What brands do you stock?

We carry Bosch, Makita, DeWalt, Stanley, Hikoki, KPT, Ideal, Planet Power, Ingco, Total and more.

Do you offer tool repair services?

Yes. We provide expert repair and maintenance support for major power-tool brands, with genuine spare parts whenever available.

What are your business hours?

We are open Sunday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. The showroom is closed on Saturday.

Do you sell wholesale?

Yes. We supply power tools, electrical equipment, accessories and spares for contractors, workshops and businesses at wholesale prices.
